title: Reversal of the 2026-08-14 Confirmed record on Dr. Roland Hollós's primary employment
prior_record: decision_log/fieldwise-open-items-fold_2026-08-14.json and the fieldwise-run-01 CO_SUPERVISOR records: 'ELTE, not HUN-REN, is his primary employment, and his supervision under this action is carried out only at the beneficiary' — recorded Confirmed as an operator decision. That record made him an ELTE co-supervisor and satisfied the supervision-at-the-beneficiary requirement under the ELTE-hosted configuration.
new_record: Under the ATK-hosted configuration, Dr. Hollós is the PRIMARY SUPERVISOR at the recruiting organisation, HUN-REN ATK, and his ATK employment carries the supervision. The ATK staff page (https://atk.hun-ren.hu/en/munkatarsak/hollos-roland-en/, consulted 2026-08-28) evidences the ATK employment: research associate, Department of Crop Production, hollos.roland@atk.hun-ren.hu.
resolution_method: The two records are not a factual contradiction but a configuration change: the 2026-08-14 record answered 'which employment carries supervision at the beneficiary' when the beneficiary was ELTE; the host switch changes the beneficiary, so the same MSCA requirement now binds his ATK employment. The 2026-08-14 record is formally reversed rather than silently overwritten, so its reasoning stays legible. Which employment is 'primary' as between ELTE and ATK is no longer the load-bearing question and is NOT asserted here; what is asserted is that his ATK employment exists (evidenced) and that supervision under this action is carried at ATK, the recruiting organisation (operator decision).
prevailing_tier: Tier 3 documented state under the explicit operator instruction (authority level 1); the web evidence corroborates.
residual_open: His position grade and start date at ATK, and his formal acceptance of the supervisor role, remain for ATK's written confirmation — declared under keys hollos_supervisor_acceptance and person_months_ATK_supervisor (working_assumptions.json).
